text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Splendid... splendid!!
Today was truly a day worthy of bathing
in the morning sunrise after all!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Coming all the way out to where we could see the sunrise was worth it—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*—... Ugh,
I will not give in to drowsiness!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That day, Tanino Gimlet looked sleepy the whole time...
It seemed she hadn't gotten a good rest."
